newsitem.title: Belgium: Belgium sold 3.8 bln Bfr state notes to date. [CORRECTED 16:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Belgium sold 3.8 bln Bfr state notes to date. [CORRECTED 16:15 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline from "Belgium sells 6.35 bln Bfr state notes in two days". Note that the figures for the individual issues are also running totals.)
The Belgian finance ministry said on Friday an issue of state notes had raised 3.844 billion Belgian francs by the end of the second day of subscriptions.
The ministry said that to date it had sold 2.683 billion francs of five year notes, extendable to seven years. The notes carry a fixed coupon of 4.70 percent.
Notes with revisable coupons and put options after three, five and seven years had raised 1.161 billion francs to date, the finance ministry said.
Subscriptions close on December 17. -- Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6817, Fax +32 2 230 7710
